entities.summary: Amanda Kessel is an American ice hockey executive and former professional player, currently serving as Manager of Minor League Operations for the Pittsburgh Penguins of the National Hockey League and Assistant General Manager of the Wilkes-Barre/Scranton Penguins of the American Hockey League.
